about.description: Kinesis provides tokenized access to physical commodities and precious metals through blockchain infrastructure. It enables fractional ownership and efficient settlement of commodity positions.
about.registryInfo: Kinesis Money (UK; ABX Group / Allocated Bullion Exchange parent). Operates the Kinesis Monetary System with KAU (gold) and KAG (silver) physically-backed tokens. Founded 2018. Backed by direct purchase agreements with refiners; 1:1 allocated physical bullion in vaults across the UK, US, Singapore, Switzerland.

fees.revenueNotes: Kinesis fee schedule: 45 bps for blockchain mint/transfer and currency transfers (KAU/KAG between accounts), 22 bps for trades on Kinesis Exchange, 22 bps for Kinesis Pay spending transactions. NO storage fees - vaulting costs covered by a share of transaction-fee revenue (via partnership with ABX). 57.5% of all platform fees redistributed monthly to users as gold/silver-denominated yields. Source: https://kinesis.money/about-us/fees/
